hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path" | { read -r f; case "$f" in */substack-os/*.js) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/substack-os" && npm test 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }

jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path" | { read -r f; root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; rel="${f#"$root"/}"; case "$rel" in landing/*.py|offload/*.py|audits/*.py|voice_clone/*.py) p="${rel%%/*}"; python3 -c "import pytest" 2>/dev/null || { echo "pytest not importable; skipping $p tests (run scripts/setup.sh)" >&2; exit 0; }; out=$(cd "$root" && python3 -m pytest "$p/tests" -q 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
